description: This file provides utility functions for mapping status strings and arbitrary keys to deterministic color values, intended for visualizing statuses with consistent and high-contrast colors suitable for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Generates a deterministic pastel-ish HSL color from an input string, producing distinct hues for different strings while maintaining saturation and lightness suitable for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a given status string to a theme color (e.g., primary, success, error). If the status is unknown, it generates a deterministic color from the string.
